prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Companion", "Preview how your pet looks and reacts on your desktop before official adoption.", "Looks Perfect!"]
1: ["Preparing Your Pet's New Desktop Habitat", "Setting up desktop overlays, tray controls, and custom pet animations...", "Configuring Desktop Environment"]
2: ["Welcome Home! Let's Try Your Pet Controls", "Learn how to summon, drag, and interact with your pet on your desktop.", "Quick Desktop Pet Checklist", "Try moving your pet or opening the tray menu right now.", "Click and drag pet across screen", "Right click pet to open control menu", "I'm Ready!"]
3: ["Save Your Pet & Sync Across Devices", "Sign in now to lock in your pet's adoption progress and settings.", "Save & Complete Setup"]
4: ["Taking longer than expected? Tap below to retry or request a sign-in magic link.", "Sign In with Email Link"]
5: ["Ensuring desktop overlay permissions are active so your pet can roam freely on your screen."]
6: ["Choose Your Companion's Origin", "Select a ready-to-adopt desktop pet or create a custom pet from your photo."]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Complete adoption to unlock exclusive starter pet toys and bonus custom background accessories!", "Includes Starter Toy Pack & 100 Treats"]
8: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Dock", "Your pet lives in your system tray! Click the pet anytime to open quick controls.", "Got It, Start Playing!"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Pick any path to get started immediately. You can always change pets or customize new ones later!"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras, bonus items, and gifts
